GAPMINDER.name: Gapminder — long-run total fertility rate
GAPMINDER.citation: Gapminder Foundation, compiled from Mattias Lindgren's historic “babies per woman” estimates. Used only where no official vital-statistics-based reconstruction (HFD) or UN estimate is available.

HFD.name: Human Fertility Database
HFD.citation: Human Fertility Database (Max Planck Institute for Demographic Research and Vienna Institute of Demography), via Our World in Data. Period TFR reconstructed from official birth registration statistics; coverage starts in different years per country (Sweden 1891 through Germany/Italy 1950). United Kingdom pre-1950 uses the England & Wales series (~89% of UK population).

UN_WPP.name: UN Population Division — World Population Prospects
UN_WPP.citation: UN World Population Prospects (2024 revision), via Our World in Data, for 1950–1959. From 1960 birthrate.io switches to World Bank WDI.
